note: Written predictions are published ONLY for HIGH-confidence picks. Every factual claim below is traceable to an official source listed in 'sources'; the only opinion is the selection itself. Comparative claims were checked against the official table before publishing.

predictions.headline: Zebre's leaking defence points to a home win for Connacht in Galway
predictions.body: Selection: Connacht to win the match. Connacht sit 14th in the United Rugby Championship on 5 points after three rounds, but they now meet the one side below them at Dexcom Stadium. Zebre Parma are 16th and winless, with 116 points conceded in three matches - an average of 38.7 per game - and they lost 12-29 at home to Edinburgh in Round 3. Connacht went down 36-19 at Glasgow on 9 October, so they will be keen to bank a win here. Zebre have conceded 17 tries in three games, and that trend, rather than anything Connacht have shown so far, is what makes the home side the call. Our price is short, so the handicap is the better way in.

predictions.selection: Vodacom Bulls to win (3-way match betting)
predictions.headline: Loftus form guide: the Bulls' 126 points in three games meets a winless Ulster
predictions.body: Selection: Bulls to win. The Bulls have scored 126 points across three rounds - 42 per game - and hold the best points differential in the competition at +72, after beating the Lions 57-15 at Loftus Versfeld on 10 October. Ulster arrive 11th with no wins from three, having drawn 26-26 with Munster at the Affidea Stadium in Round 3 after drawing the round before. Ulster have scored 88 points in three games, so they are not toothless, but they have not yet closed out an 80-minute performance. An early kick-off at Loftus Versfeld, against a pack that has conceded only seven tries, is a hard place to find a first win.

predictions.selection: DHL Stormers to win (3-way match betting)
predictions.headline: Stormers' defensive record should hold up against a Scarlets side still finding its feet
predictions.body: Selection: Stormers to win. The Stormers are fourth on 11 points with a +27 differential, built on 54 points conceded in three matches, and they beat the Sharks 39-22 at DHL Stadium on 10 October - the same venue as this fixture. Scarlets are 12th on 7 points and have conceded 85, most recently edging Benetton 27-26 in Round 3, a match decided by a single point. Scarlets have lost two of three and now travel to a side that has conceded the joint-fewest points in the league. With the Stormers' forward carries and lineout drive working, the hosts should be able to keep Scarlets at arm's length and cover a moderate handicap.

predictions.headline: Leinster's 29-5 dismantling of Cardiff is the form line that matters
predictions.body: Selection: Leinster to win. Leinster are only 10th on 8 points after an uncharacteristically slow start - one win from three - but that win was a 29-5 demolition of Cardiff in Round 3 in which they conceded a single try. Munster are a place higher on 9 points after drawing 26-26 at Ulster, and they have scored 72 points while conceding 74. Leinster have the fourth-fewest points conceded in the league (58) and face a Munster side that has won once in three. With home advantage and a defence that has given up eight tries in three matches, Leinster look the more solid side; take the outright market rather than a tight handicap.

predictions.selection: Buffalo Sabres money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Flyers' 0-4-1 road record makes Buffalo the call at KeyBank Center
predictions.body: Selection: Sabres money line. Buffalo are 4-3-2 for 10 points and have been respectable at home at 3-2-0, scoring 27 goals across nine games while conceding 34. Philadelphia are the story here for the wrong reasons: 2-6-3 with 17 goals in 11 games, the lowest goals-per-game rate of any Eastern Conference team in the NHL.com standings, and a road record of 0-4-1. The Flyers have won their last two games, which is why this is not a bigger price, but both wins came with home ice. Buffalo's home form against a Philadelphia side that has not won on the road all season makes the Sabres the side to be on; the puck line is a step too far given Buffalo's own defensive numbers.

predictions.headline: Unbeaten league leaders Oyonnax travel to a leaky Montauban defence
predictions.body: Selection: Oyonnax to win. Oyonnax are the only unbeaten side left in Pro D2, 7 wins from 7 for 33 points, and they own the division's best attack with 313 points scored this season behind top scorer Luka Matkava. Montauban sit 8th on 17 points; they beat Brive at home in round 6 but then shipped 54 points in a 54-28 defeat at Dax in round 7, a defensive collapse that does not bode well against a side averaging over 44 points a game on the road. Take Oyonnax to extend their unbeaten run, with the handicap line a sensible alternative to the short-priced moneyline.

predictions.headline: Narbonne's league-worst defence (296 conceded) is a problem CA Brive should exploit
predictions.body: Selection: Brive to win. Narbonne sit 14th in Pro D2 on 9 points and have conceded 296 points in seven matches, the worst defensive record in the division, including a 57-14 thrashing by Oyonnax and a 49-28 loss to Colomiers in their last two outings. CA Brive, captained by Said Hireche, are 4th on 21 points with a +42 points difference, and although they were upset at Montauban in round 6, they have the firepower (206 points scored) to punish a side shipping this many points. Back Brive to win on the road; Narbonne's defence has not stopped anyone in a month.

predictions.headline: Aurillac's first away win of the season arrives just as bottom club Nevers visit
predictions.body: Selection: Aurillac to win. Aurillac have endured an inconsistent campaign but just claimed their first away win of the season, edging Beziers 25-24 in round 7 after holding off a late rally. USON Nevers arrive bottom of Pro D2 with zero wins from seven matches and only 4 points on the board, having just been beaten 38-7 by Agen and conceding a division-high rate of points relative to games played. With Aurillac's confidence rising after that Beziers win and Nevers still searching for a first points-table result, the home side at Stade Jean Alric is the clear pick, even allowing for Aurillac's own mixed home form this season.

predictions.headline: Still-unbeaten Provence Rugby defend home patch against a Beziers side low on points
predictions.body: Selection: Provence to win. Provence Rugby are the division's second unbeaten side, 7 wins from 7 for 29 points, and they stayed perfect by grinding out a narrow win at Soyaux-Angouleme in round 7 to preserve their record as Oyonnax's closest challenger. AS Beziers Herault, despite marquee new centre Malakai Fekitoa leading their attack, sit 15th on 9 points after a 25-24 defeat to Aurillac and have conceded 240 points in seven games, second-worst in Pro D2. At Stade Maurice-David, Provence's unbeaten home form should be too strong, though the scale of the current handicap line is steep given how tight Beziers' recent matches have been.

predictions.headline: Captain Antoine Dupont's return to form underlines why Toulouse are Top 14 leaders
predictions.body: Selection: Toulouse to win. Stade Toulousain lead the Top 14 with 5 wins from 6 for 24 points and the competition's best points difference at +73, built on 197 points scored. Captain Antoine Dupont, back from his long ACL lay-off, has scored two braces this season - against Montpellier and against Bayonne - and told reporters on 18 October he is now reaping the benefit of a full pre-season. USA Perpignan sit 9th on 13 points having lost three of their six matches, including defeats to Montpellier and Racing 92. At the Stadium against a side this dominant at home, Toulouse are the clear selection even on the generous handicap line Perpignan are being given.

predictions.headline: Bottom club Pioneers Vorarlberg have won nothing all season - Pustertal should cash in
predictions.body: Selection: Pustertal money line. HC Pustertal sit 7th in the ICEHL on 17 points from 10 games under new captain Daniel Glira, who has made 583 appearances for the Wolves, with top scorers Henry Bowlby and Cole Bardreau - who combined for 132 points last season - again leading the attack. Pioneers Vorarlberg are rock bottom with just 1 point from 12 games and zero regulation wins all season, conceding 52 goals. Pustertal have lost their own top current scorer Austin Rueschhoff to injury, but the gulf in class and Vorarlberg's historically bad defensive record make Bruneck a straightforward home moneyline play.

predictions.selection: HCB Sudtirol Alperia money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: League leaders Bolzano just ended Linz's six-game run - Innsbruck are next in line
predictions.body: Selection: HCB Sudtirol Alperia money line. Bolzano lead the ICEHL outright with 24 points from 11 games under captain Luca Frigo, the club's 20th captain and a player who passed 100 career goals for the Foxes last season; they reclaimed top spot on 18 October by beating Black Wings Linz 5-0, snapping Linz's six-game winning streak. HC Innsbruck, by contrast, are 10th with 15 points from 12 games and a losing record. Playing at the Sparkasse Arena off the back of that statement win, Bolzano should have too much firepower for an Innsbruck side yet to find consistency this season.

predictions.selection: Farjestad BK money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Timra's title-winning scorer left for Switzerland - Farjestad's unbeaten run should continue
predictions.body: Selection: Farjestad BK money line. Farjestad lead the SHL table unbeaten in regulation, 9 wins from 10 games for 27 points under captain Linus Johansson, having scored 40 goals and conceded only 11. Timra IK, led by captain Anton Lander, sit well down the table after losing last season's SHL top scorer Jonathan Dahlen - who had 30 goals in 50 games - to Swiss club Langnau over the summer, a departure that has visibly hurt their attack this season. With Farjestad's defence conceding barely a goal a game and Timra still searching for the scoring touch Dahlen used to provide, the away moneyline is the clear selection at Timra Isstadion.

predictions.selection: KAC Klagenfurt money line (2-way, overtime included)
predictions.headline: Captain Thomas Hundertpfund's return has coincided with a top-four Klagenfurt revival
predictions.body: Selection: KAC Klagenfurt money line. EC-KAC sit 4th in the ICEHL with 21 points from 12 games, with club icon and captain Thomas Hundertpfund back in the side this season after a long injury lay-off, and forwards Nick Petersen and Raphael Herburger both on 10 points apiece to lead the scoring. Fehervar AV19 are 13th with 13 points from 12 games, having conceded 39 goals, the second-worst defensive record in the league. At the Heidi Horten-Arena, with Klagenfurt's attack clicking and Fehervar's defence leaking goals at a high rate, the home moneyline is the pick.
